zh.title: 波蘭航空開闢華沙至河內直飛航線 將以波音787營運
zh.summary: 波蘭航空宣佈將於2027年3月31日開航華沙蕭邦機場（WAW）至越南河內內排國際機場（HAN）的直飛航線，成為該公司在亞洲的第五個長途航點。新航線將全年營運，每週提供三個往返班次，並採用波音787客機執飛。
body: 波蘭航空宣佈將開闢華沙蕭邦機場與越南河內內排國際機場之間的直飛航線，首航定於2027年3月31日。目前機票已在波蘭航空官網及各大通路公開發售。
該航線將以波音787客機執飛，全年每週提供三個往返班次。華沙起飛時間為週一、三、五當地時間15時15分，去程約需10小時25分；河內起飛時間則為週二、四、六當地時間8時35分，回程約需11小時20分。
河內是波蘭航空繼東京、首爾、新德里與曼谷之後，在亞洲的第五個長途航點。波蘭航空董事兼執行商業長 Robert Ludera 表示，開設新航線展現了公司拓展亞洲市場的企圖心，並能進一步將華沙打造為連接中東歐與亞洲發展迅速地區的轉運樞紐。

en.title: LOT Polish Airlines to Launch Direct Warsaw-Hanoi Service with Boeing 787
en.summary: LOT Polish Airlines has announced a new direct service connecting Warsaw Chopin Airport (WAW) and Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) in Hanoi, Vietnam, scheduled to begin on March 31, 2027. Operating year-round with three weekly round trips on Boeing 787 Dreamliner aircraft, Hanoi will become the carrier's fifth long-haul destination in Asia alongside Tokyo, Seoul, New Delhi, and Bangkok. The airline aims to strengthen its footprint in Asia while expanding Warsaw as a transfer hub connecting Central and Eastern Europe with fast-growing Asian markets.
body: LOT Polish Airlines has announced a new direct route between Warsaw Chopin Airport and Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi, Vietnam, with ticket sales now open ahead of the inaugural flight scheduled for March 31, 2027.

The service will operate three times weekly year-round using Boeing 787 Dreamliner aircraft. Outbound flights will depart Warsaw on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays at 15:15 local time with an estimated flight duration of 10 hours and 25 minutes. Return flights from Hanoi are scheduled for Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays at 08:35 local time, lasting approximately 11 hours and 20 minutes.

Hanoi becomes LOT's fifth long-haul Asian destination alongside Tokyo, Seoul, New Delhi, and Bangkok. Robert Ludera, Board Member and Chief Commercial Officer at LOT, noted that the expansion reflects the airline's ambition to strengthen its Asian footprint and position Warsaw as a connecting hub.

zh.title: 全球航空運能成長放緩 非洲國內市場展現韌性與成長
zh.summary: 根據航空分析機構資料，今年夏季全球航空運能僅年增1%，低於原先預期的3%成長率。然而，非洲航空市場展現強勁韌性，其中尼日利亞國內航空運能年增達36%。分析指出，尼日利亞採行開普敦條約後，吸引包含AirCap在內的主要租賃公司投入乾租機隊，進一步推動當地市場擴張。
body: 根據航空分析機構 OAG 與 Midas Aviation 的最新統計資料，全球航空公司在今年夏季的客運運能僅較去年同期成長 1%，遠低於先前預測的 3% 成長率。分析指出，全球運能成長低於預期的主因，是航空公司因應中東與烏克蘭等地區的局勢不穩定，對整體航線與運能進行了重新調整。
儘管全球市場面臨地緣不確定性，非洲航空市場卻展現出相較於其他地區更為強勁的抗壓能力。航空諮詢機構 seanmendes.com 總監 Sean Mendes 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日參加 OAG 主辦的線上研討會時指出，非洲航空市場在經歷票價上漲及部分區域成長趨緩的情況下，並未出現實質萎縮，顯現出對全球外部衝擊的良好韌性。
在非洲各國中，尼日利亞的國內航空市場表現尤為突出。OAG 首席分析師 John Grant 指出，尼日利亞國內市場運能實現了高達 36% 的年成長率。這項成長主要受益於尼日利亞將《開普敦條約》（Cape Town Convention）國內法化，此舉大幅提升了國際租賃公司向當地航空公司提供乾租（dry lease）飛機的意願，包含 AirCap 在內的主要租賃業者已開始在該國投放機隊。
分析師同時提到，相較於過往尼日利亞業者主要依賴歐洲 ACMI 市場在冬季或聖誕假期提供短期濕租（wet lease）支援，今年已有更多租賃飛機以乾租形式進駐。此外，專家指出非洲市場的訂票時間極為緊湊，許多旅客會在出發前一天才購買機票，而尼日利亞市場高度分散且缺乏單一主導品牌，未來預計將透過聯盟與合作夥伴關係促進進一步整合。

en.title: African Domestic Aviation Shows Resilience as Global Capacity Growth Slows
en.summary: Global airline capacity grew by just 1% year-on-year during the summer season, missing earlier forecasts of 3% as airlines adjusted capacity in response to regional conflicts. In contrast, Africa's domestic aviation sector has demonstrated notable resilience. Industry analysts from OAG and Midas Aviation highlight Nigeria as a key driver of this growth, with domestic capacity surging 36% year-on-year. The expansion is partly attributed to Nigeria's domestication of the Cape Town Convention, which has encouraged major international aircraft lessors, including AirCap, to place dry-leased airframes with local airlines, shifting away from previous reliance on seasonal European wet leases.
body: According to data from aviation analysts OAG and Midas Aviation, global airline capacity has increased by just 1% year-on-year during the summer season. This rate falls significantly short of the 3% growth originally forecast for the period, largely as a result of carriers adjusting their flight schedules and reallocating capacity in response to geopolitical instability in the Middle East and Ukraine.

Despite the broader global slowdown, Africa's domestic aviation sector has proven remarkably resilient. Speaking during an online panel discussion hosted by OAG on July 29, 2026, Sean Mendes, director at aviation consultancy seanmendes.com, stated that while ticket prices have risen and growth has slowed in certain sub-regions, the continent's air travel market has avoided contraction and continues to withstand global market shocks.

Nigeria has emerged as a key focal point of domestic aviation expansion across the continent. John Grant, chief analyst at OAG, highlighted that Nigeria's domestic aviation capacity surged by 36% year-on-year. He noted that this growth was substantially driven by Nigeria's domestication of the Cape Town Convention, which has given international aircraft lessors greater confidence to execute dry leases with local airlines. Major leasing firms, including AirCap, have subsequently started placing airframes directly into the Nigerian market.

This strategic shift represents a notable change from previous operational patterns, where Nigerian air carriers depended heavily on European wet-lease ACMI providers to cover seasonal demand spikes during the winter and Christmas periods. Industry analysts, including Deirdre Fulton of Midas Aviation, also observed that passenger booking windows across Africa remain extremely compressed, with a large volume of tickets purchased just one day prior to travel. Experts further anticipate that market fragmentation in Nigeria will eventually lead to industry consolidation through strategic alliances and partnerships rather than direct acquisitions.
